name: Country Emissions Report
purpose: Compares each country's yearly CO2 emissions, in total and per person

inputs.population: Number of people living in the country
inputs.annual_co2_mt: Fossil CO2 emitted inside the country that year, in million tonnes, not counting land-use change
inputs.co2_per_person_t: Fossil CO2 emitted per person that year, in tonnes, not counting land-use change
inputs.co2_change_pct: Percentage change in fossil CO2 emissions from the year before
inputs.coal_co2_mt: CO2 emitted from burning coal that year, in million tonnes
inputs.carbon_tax_rate: Price the country charges per tonne of CO2 emitted
inputs.renewable_share_pct: Percentage of the country's energy that comes from renewable sources
